tool.name: PRINSEQ Trimmer
tool.description: Trim and discard reads and read sections.
tool.command:
prinseq-lite.pl -fastq '$input_files.query' #if $trim_options.trim_left -trim_left $trim_options.trim_left #end if #if $trim_options.trim_right -trim_right $trim_options.trim_right #end if #if $trim_options.trim_to_len -trim_to_len $trim_options.trim_to_len #end if #if $filter_options.min_len -min_len $filter_options.min_len #end if #if $filter_options.max_len -max_len $filter_options.max_len #end if #if $filter_options.min_gc -min_gc $filter_options.min_gc #end if #if $filter_options.max_gc -max_gc $filter_options.max_gc #end if #if $filter_options.min_qual_mean -min_qual_mean $filter_options.min_qual_mean #end if #if $filter_options.max_qual_mean -max_qual_mean $filter_options.max_qual_mean #end if -out_good trimmed -out_bad null &&
## PRINSEQ writes no file when every read is discarded. touch trimmed.fastq

param.name: query
param.label: FASTQ file
param.help: Reads to trim. Select a list collection to trim every file in it

param.name: trim_left
param.label: Trim bases at the 5' end
param.help: Remove this number of bases from the start of every read [-trim_left]

param.name: trim_right
param.label: Trim bases at the 3' end
param.help: Remove this number of bases from the end of every read [-trim_right]

param.name: trim_to_len
param.label: Trim reads to LENGTH
param.help: Shorten every read to this length by removing bases from the 3' end [-trim_to_len]

param.name: min_len
param.label: Minimum length
param.help: Discard reads shorter than this length [-min_len]

param.name: max_len
param.label: Maximum length
param.help: Discard reads longer than this length [-max_len]

param.name: min_gc
param.label: Minimum GC content
param.help: Discard reads with a GC content below this percentage [-min_gc]

param.name: max_gc
param.label: Maximum GC content
param.help: Discard reads with a GC content above this percentage [-max_gc]

param.name: min_qual_mean
param.label: Minimum mean quality score
param.help: Discard reads with a mean quality score below this value [-min_qual_mean]

param.name: max_qual_mean
param.label: Maximum mean quality score
param.help: Discard reads with a mean quality score above this value [-max_qual_mean]

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark See PRINSEQ documentation: https://prinseq.sourceforge.net/manual.html for full software details.
**What it does** Trims bases from the ends of every read, and discards reads by length, GC content and mean quality score. Leave an option empty or at 0 to skip it. If every read is discarded, the output is empty.
Select a list collection to trim every file in it. Galaxy runs the tool once for every file and returns a list of trimmed files.
